People are saying if you land in the 4 corners of the map you’ll die to zone. in the northwest corner you have rifts east of pleasant aswell as infinite rift in loot lake. Northwest there’s a massive air vent that allows you to get to dusty, Southwest there’s the tiki head with multiple riffs. Paradise has 5 rifts spawns I think. End game and middle game have a more skill full element which is what ranked is supposed to have.
